journal_lines: The stone rang like a bell when struck. Inside: violet. Still growing.
Hollow in the rock. The crystals were still forming. Took what was ready.
Geode. Cracked it open. Purple light from inside, better than expected.
Tapped a wall that did not sound right. Right was the wrong word. Hollow was the right one.
Inside the geode the crystals were arranged like teeth in a careful mouth.
Light came out of the geode that had been waiting a long time to come out.
Took the loose ones. The wall ones I left, the way you leave the largest fish in a lake.
Worked it open slowly. A geode opens once.
